exposure: Subclinical hypothyroidism (defined by two different TSH cutoffs: >3.0 mIU/L and >3.7 mIU/L)
outcome: Expression levels of mitochondria-related genes (PGC-1β, TFAM, SOD2, NRF-2)
Expression levels of microRNAs (hsa-let-7d-3p and hsa-miR-345-5p)
cohort: 77 at-term pregnant women undergoing planned cesarean section
finding: Subclinical hypothyroidism in pregnancy showed a trend towards decreased mitochondrial gene expressions, and two miRNAs (hsa-let-7d-3p and hsa-miR-345-5p) were upregulated in both maternal and cord blood of women with subclinical hypothyroidism.
